properties.statement: An earlier sequence of definitions that fail eligibility at a node has no effect on selection from the remaining definitions.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (matcher : Esm.Rewrite.MatchRule) (shadowed : List String) (term : Esm.Document.Json) (earlier candidates : List Esm.Rewrite.Rule), (∀ rule ∈ earlier, matcher shadowed rule term = none) → Esm.Rewrite.select (earlier ++ candidates) matcher shadowed term = Esm.Rewrite.select candidates matcher shadowed term

properties.statement: Among two eligible definitions with the same priority and the same presence of a where clause, the first definition wins.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (matcher : Esm.Rewrite.MatchRule) (shadowed : List String) (term : Esm.Document.Json) (first second : Esm.Rewrite.Rule) (firstCapture secondCapture : Esm.Rewrite.Bindings), matcher shadowed first term = some firstCapture → matcher shadowed second term = some secondCapture → first.priority = second.priority → first.constraints.isSome = second.constraints.isSome → Esm.Rewrite.select [first, second] matcher shadowed term = some (first, firstCapture)

properties.statement: A successful fixpoint uses at most the number of productive passes remaining at the instance's starting depth.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (rules : List Esm.Rewrite.Rule) (matcher : Esm.Rewrite.MatchRule) (term : Esm.Document.Json) (depth : Nat) (result : Esm.Rewrite.RewriteResult), Esm.Rewrite.rewriteTracked rules matcher term depth = .ok result → result.productivePasses ≤ Esm.Rewrite.maxRewritePasses - depth

properties.statement: For a legal starting depth the fixpoint reports non-convergence at the attempted productive pass immediately beyond the depth limit.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (rules : List Esm.Rewrite.Rule) (matcher : Esm.Rewrite.MatchRule) (term : Esm.Document.Json) (depth : Nat) (failure : Esm.Rewrite.Nontermination), depth ≤ Esm.Rewrite.maxRewritePasses → Esm.Rewrite.rewriteTracked rules matcher term depth = .error failure → failure.depth = Esm.Rewrite.maxRewritePasses + 1

properties.statement: The structural matcher gives no rule eligibility at an apply_operator root, independently of its bindings and the surrounding instance.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (independent : String) (shapes : Esm.Rewrite.ShapeEnv) (instanceArgs : Esm.Rewrite.InstanceEnv) (shadowed : List String) (rule : Esm.Rewrite.Rule) (fields : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), Esm.Rewrite.eligibleWithTime independent shapes instanceArgs shadowed rule (.obj (("op", .str "apply_operator") :: fields)) = none
